section.div: A self-hosted dashboard that puts all your feeds in one place
简易 Windows 副屏 Dashboard，复古终端风，高度模块化。真正的桌面终端，可以运行自定义快捷指令。还有更多小工具：硬件监控、Home Assistant 控制、服务状态、天气/日程和其它。
灵感源自 macOS 动态屏保体验，为 Windows 打造的轻量原生动态壁纸与屏保应用，支持多显示器、智能性能副本和低功耗播放。
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on any consumer hardware: one-click install for Windows / Linux. Strata inference engine, OpenAI/Anthropic API on localhost, optional image input.
This repository contains all public UVR models, with possibly a few private ones included.
Ultimate Vocal Remover 5 with Gradio UI. Separate an audio file into various stems, using multiple models
Solid State Logic（SSL）Live 数字调音台中文操作手册。基于官方帮助文档整理，提供清晰的中文技术资料与术语对照，支持网页阅读、PWA 安装及离线查阅，为现场扩声和音频工程师打造。
